title: aralia racemosa subsp. bicrenata
intro: Aralia racemosa subsp. bicrenata, commonly known as American spikenard or eastern American spikenard, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Araliaceae. The plant has been used for centuries in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Aralia racemosa subsp. bicrenata include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its potential to treat digestive issues and respiratory problems. Its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpenes, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
